question: Which of the following urban areas is identified as Million Plus Urban Agglomerations Cities as per Census of India 2001?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As per Census of India 2001, Million Plus Urban Agglomerations Cities are those urban areas with a population exceeding one million.
 
• Lucknow, the capital city of Uttar Pradesh, was identified as one of the Million Plus Urban Agglomerations Cities in the Census 2001.
 
• Lucknow's population crossed the one million mark during the 2001 census, making it eligible for this classification.
 
• Other notable cities like Chandigarh also fall under this category, but Lucknow specifically satisfies the criteria for the given question.
 
• Million Plus Cities are significant for urban planning and resource allocation by the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urban Agglomeration:**

 
 
• An Urban Agglomeration (UA) consists of a core city and its adjoining areas forming a continuous urban spread.
 
• It includes the main city, towns, and outgrowths (like railway colonies, university campuses, etc.) linked to the urban core.
 
 
 
• **Million Plus Cities:**
 
 
• These cities have populations exceeding one million as per Census data.
 
• Such cities are key focus areas for infrastructure development under schemes like Smart Cities Mission.
 
 
 
• **Census of India:**
 
 
• The Census is conducted every 10 years to collect demographic, social, and economic data.
 
• Census 2001 was the 14th National Census exercise conducted in India.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Million Plus Cities:**
 
 
• These cities are crucial for economic activities, governance, and urban development.
 
• They often serve as hubs for trade, education, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
